name: Negotiation pilot
description: Study AI roles, authority and negotiated prices.

scenario.title: Choose a supply partner
scenario.instructions: You are sourcing a component for a new production run. Compare the three suppliers, consult the assistant, and submit your final selection. You may accept, reject, or override the assistant's choice.
scenario.consent_text: This pilot records your conversation, choices, response timings, and interaction counts within this page, including typing, clicks, hover, and copy/paste counts. It does not record individual keys or clipboard contents. Use a study code rather than your name. Participation is voluntary; you may stop at any time.
scenario.knowledge: Cost is per unit. Reliability is the percentage of on-time deliveries. Lead time is in days. Consider the trade-off between cost, delivery speed, and reliability.

negotiation.title: Negotiate a supply agreement
negotiation.instructions: Negotiate a unit price for the stated quantity. Send offers or discuss terms, then record a final price or finish without agreement. No real order is placed.
negotiation.knowledge: Prices are per unit. The stated quantity is fixed. Only unit price is negotiated in this pilot.
